summary.text: Rod Montoya, listed by Ballotpedia as Rodney Montoya, is a Republican state representative from New Mexico House District 1 who took office on January 1, 2015, and is on the November 3, 2026 ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: Montoya's professional experience includes working as a coal miner, and Ballotpedia lists his profession as miner.
In the 2025-2026 session, Montoya serves on the Energy, Environment and Natural Resources Committee and the Taxation & Revenue Committee.
In 2023-2024 Montoya's assignments also included the Appropriations and Finance Committee and the Rules and Order of Business Committee.
